atlases.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit the FIRST image: a 4-column 5-row atlas of twenty crustaceans. SECOND image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, the original game's round colorful toy fish. Redraw ALL twenty creatures in the exact order and species of the first image to match the second image's friendly rounded stylized 3D toy aesthetic: softly sculpted satin material, simpler broad color shapes, expressive slightly larger dark bead eyes, rounded chunky anatomy, gentle highlights. Remove photographic shell pores, hair, wet hard specular shine and hyperrealistic details. Maintain recognizable species markings and full appendages. Exact 4 columns by 5 equal rows, each animal strictly centered in its own equal cell, at least 12% EMPTY margin on every side, no cross-cell overlaps. Shrimp face RIGHT, crabs front three-quarter view as original. Antennae must be continuous clean slightly thicker graceful curves that remain legible at thumbnail size, all fit inside the cell. Clean genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, including all gaps between antennae/legs/claws. Preserve pale/white markings on the animals. NO white matte, no checkerboard painted into pixels, no shadows outside silhouettes, no ground, no speckles, no detached fragments, no text/grid. Output square high resolution production PNG atlas. Same twenty species in same reading order; no additional creatures.

Redraw target to match reference's rounded charming colorful stylized 3D toy characters, simple satin sculpted surfaces, soft broad highlights and simplified markings. Far less realistic: NO wet photoreal specular detail, pores, stone texture or gritty microdetail. Keep all twenty species, identities and exact reading order. Square PNG with genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, especially completely clear gaps between jellyfish tentacles and slug appendages. No shadows, speckles, detached debris, text, checkerboard pixels or white matte. EXACT equal 4 columns and 5 rows; each animal centered and scaled down to occupy at most 76% of cell width AND height so ALL appendages fit with a 12% empty margin on each side. Jellyfish upright, bells at top and tentacles hanging below; clean smooth continuous rounded tentacles, softly lavender/blue tinted semitransparent bells (not solid white); no cut tentacles. Same row content as target: row1 scallop/oyster/mussel/Manila clam; row2 razor clam/abalone/giant clam/queen conch; row3 tiger cowrie/turban snail/moon jellyfish/amber sea nettle jellyfish; row4 blue blubber jellyfish/blue dragon slug/sea bunny/Spanish dancer; row5 orange cushion star/blue star/purple urchin/spotted sea cucumber.
